records.title:
UDAN SCHEME FOR REGIONAL AIR
CONNECTIVITY
details:
QUESTION ASKED BY:-Shri Shambhu
Sharan Patel,
Shri Deepak
Prakash, Shri
Brij Lal, Shri
Aditya Prasad,
Dr. Parmar
Jashvantsinh
Salamsinh, Shri
Mithlesh Kumar,
Dr. Dinesh
Sharma, Shri
Chunnilal
Garasiya
Assurance:-(e): Bokaro Airport, owned by
Steel Authority of India
Limited (SAIL), has been
identified for development to
enable the commencement of
RCS flight operations under
the UDAN scheme. For
development of Bokaro
airport, an amount of
Rs.80.03 crore has
been sanctioned, out of which
Rs.78.50 crore has already
been incurred towards the
development of the airport
infrastructure. Licensing of
airport is pending for want of
regulatory compliances.
Operationalisation of RCS
routes from Bokaro Airport is
subject to readiness
of infrastructure and operator.

details:
